value.summary: This diff updates three import paths from a nested `openhuman::openhuman` prefix to `openhuman::`, reflecting a reorganisation in the vendored `openhuman-core` crate. All three called functions (`init_workspace`, `Config::load_or_init`, `workspace_dir_for_file_backend`) exist at the new paths and have identical signatures to the old ones. No logic or behaviour is changed, no new untrusted input paths are introduced, and no security or regression issues are present.
